FAQ

Questions, answered.

Who is PatuhData Accounting for?

Businesses in Indonesia that want invoicing, bookkeeping, and tax reporting in one system instead of scattered spreadsheets.

Does it work with e-Faktur?

Yes. e-Faktur sync is built in, so tax invoices and tax reports come from the same books as everything else.

How do I get started?

Contact our sales team. We set up your account and help you add your company and opening balances.

Who is behind PatuhData?

PT PatuhData Solusi Nusantara, a software company based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
